name: South System Expansion III Phase 3

values.SegmentName: South System Expansion III Project, Phase 3

monitor_reason: length: the 19.3 mi is only about 7.6 mi (12 km) of new loop pipe; 11.7 mi is replacement of existing pipe. Under the 25 km new-pipe rule.
researcher_notes: EIA August 2026 release, sheet Historical Projects (1996-2024), Excel row 719: South System Expansion III Phase 3, Southern Natural Gas Co, completed 2012-06-01, MS/AL/GA, 19.3 mi, 36 in, 125 MMcf/d, FERC docket CP09-36. A Federal Register environmental assessment notice of 19 June 2009 (E9-14452) lists the facilities of the whole South System Expansion III project, built in three phases and all in service by the second quarter of 2012. It does not label phases. By my inference, Phase 3 is the Bay Springs Loop 2.4 mi + Gallion Loop 5.2 mi + Elmore Replacement 11.7 mi = 19.3 mi, which matches EIA exactly (Phase 2 = Gwinville 12.0 + Enterprise 7.7 = 19.7 also matches). Only the two loops (7.6 mi, about 12 km) add new pipe. The Elmore piece replaces 16 in pipe with 42 in pipe. FERC approved-projects list: the whole project is 81.1 mi, 735 MMcf/d, 42,962 hp, approved 2009-08-27. Not an existing GEM row: the tracker has only the parent Southern Natural Gas Pipeline row and P7855 South System Expansion 4 Project, a different project. Tracked as monitor; if the team counts replacement pipe as length, this would become a new_row for PipelineName Southern Natural Gas Pipeline. Owner not researched for staging.
